title: Project Overview shell
goal: Add a safe project overview landing shell that gives the writer project-local workspace status and navigation using existing deterministic project data, while preserving owner-authored content boundaries and avoiding generated prose, extraction, model calls, OMI/canon/memory mutation, or Dramatica analysis.
why_now: PHASE7-IMPL-006 completed the shared owner-authored scene/note/material editor path. The next Project Workspace Foundation parent should provide a safe overview landing shell before later workspace pages expand.

include: Inventory current project workspace surfaces relevant to a safe overview shell.
Define a conservative PHASE7-IMPL-007 child sequence.
Prepare task, inventory, enrichment, and status records before runtime implementation begins.
Identify PHASE7-IMPL-007-T002 as the next source-level data contract/test child.
exclude: Generated prose, project summaries, note/material summaries, extraction, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, model/Ollama calls, OMI promotion, memory/canon mutation, metadata editing UI, Dramatica analysis, training data, JSONL, dataset artifacts, package changes, app servers, frontend builds, browser/manual validation, and runtime project fixture writes.

quality_notes: Roadmap index and implementation status are primary authority for task identity and active frontier.
Direct reads of named source files were used for implementation-surface inventory.
Existing frontend tests are source-level guards and do not substitute for browser/manual validation.
No CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context generation, MCP tools, LeanCTX, or broad discovery were run.

frontend.notes: Owns active project state, project list metadata, scene/note/material lists, OMI summary state, and the shared editor composition. No dedicated overview component exists today.
Provides project and scene/note/material navigation with ID-based selection and no Overview nav item today.
Document-neutral owner-authored body editor; should remain separate from overview display.
Provides project list/create helpers and scene/note/material/OMI helpers; no dedicated overview helper exists today.

backend.notes: Provides project, scene, note/material, OMI, bible/storyform, and Story Check routes; no dedicated overview route exists today.
Provides project metadata listing plus scene/chapter/note/material helpers that may support cheap counts if a later child needs a narrow overview helper.

tests.notes: Primary source-level regression surface for overview shell contract work.
Backend helper regression surface if a later child touches deterministic overview helper code.

child_tasks.title: Project Overview shell inventory and child-task plan
Overview data contract and source-level tests
scope: Define source-level expectations for project title/ID/status, counts, safe empty states, overview navigation, and no hidden model/extraction calls.
Avoid runtime implementation unless explicitly scoped by T002.

child_tasks.title: Backend/project data helper compatibility, if needed

acceptance_criteria: Project Overview shell has a documented data contract before runtime implementation.
Overview displays only deterministic project-local metadata/status/counts/empty states.
Overview navigation uses existing workspace routes/surfaces and does not trigger model-backed behavior.
Scene, note, material, and shared editor behavior remain stable.
Overview rendering does not read document bodies to generate summaries.

No generated prose, summaries, extraction, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, model/Ollama calls, OMI/canon/memory mutation, Dramatica analysis, training/JSONL/dataset work, browser/manual validation, package changes, app servers, or runtime project fixture changes are introduced.

commands: git diff -- docs/roadmap/tasks/PHASE7-IMPL-007.md docs/roadmap/inventory/PHASE7-IMPL-007.md docs/roadmap/enrichment/PHASE7-IMPL-007.enrichment.json docs/roadmap/implementation_status.md docs/roadmap/roadmap_index.yaml docs/roadmap/task_backlog.md docs/roadmap/phase_map.md docs/master_plan.md docs/roadmap/validation/latest_roadmap_validation.md
validation.notes: Do not use LeanCTX. If raw git diff is blocked by the local hook, record the skip.

safety_notes: Overview content must be factual UI/status content from project metadata or deterministic local records.
Owner-authored project metadata may be displayed as stored.
Overview rendering must not create files, repair metadata, promote candidates, mutate memory/canon, run Story Check, or call models.
Approved memory/canon sections are empty-state placeholders until later approved-memory implementation exists.
deferred_work: Runtime overview implementation after the T002 data contract.
Dedicated backend overview helper or route unless existing deterministic data proves insufficient.
OMI-guided setup, memory/canon shell, extraction, semantic search, generated summaries, and Dramatica analysis.
